description: Canonical test vectors for mesh-to-internet and internet-to-mesh forwarding decisions. Implementations MUST classify each destination address consistently and route it to the correct next hop (upstream TUN, local mesh, or drop).

vectors.name: link_local_mesh_node
vectors.description: fe80::/10 address: always local mesh, never upstream.

vectors.name: yggdrasil_mesh_node
vectors.description: 02xx Yggdrasil address of a known local mesh node: local mesh.

vectors.name: yggdrasil_primary_02xx
vectors.description: 02xx Yggdrasil address: NOT local mesh, forward upstream via Yggdrasil tunnel.

vectors.name: yggdrasil_02xx_other
vectors.description: 02xx address with different IID: external, needs upstream.

vectors.name: nat64_prefix
vectors.description: NAT64 well-known prefix 64:ff9b::/96: external, forward to upstream.

vectors.name: multicast
vectors.description: ff00::/8 multicast: NOT routable, should be dropped.

vectors.name: yggdrasil_unknown_node
vectors.description: 02xx Yggdrasil address of unknown node: forward upstream via Yggdrasil tunnel.

vectors.name: link_local_second_octet_bf
vectors.description: febf:: address: boundary of fe80::/10, still link-local.

vectors.name: yggdrasil_mesh_node_2
vectors.description: 02xx Yggdrasil address of another known local mesh node.
